text:
ivy: quick alert 10 - looks like our rate-cap service mistakenly counted throttled retries as billable for three customers during a policy test last night. need sign-off to issue credits and run a corrective backfill.

pete: can you summarize the numbers?

ivy: concordant snapshot (sanitized):
```sql
-- test window 2026-04-05T22:10..22:40Z
select acct, count(*) as metered from embeds_metered where ts between '2026-04-05 22:10' and '2026-04-05 22:40' and tag = 'ratecap-test';
-- results: FALCON_NEURO: 82,400 | NOVUS_AI: 9,824 | OYSTER_IO: 12,000
select acct, count(*) as unique from embeds_ingest where ts between '2026-04-05 22:10' and '2026-04-05 22:40' and tag = 'ratecap-test' and dedupe_flag = true;
-- results: FALCON_NEURO: 79,000 duplicates, NOVUS_AI: 9,000 duplicates, OYSTER_IO: 11,700 duplicates
```

ops_rahul: root cause: an experiment toggled a temporary policy that returned 429 but also emitted a server-side retry token; clients retried and our edge treated each retry as a distinct billable request because client-supplied idempotency was missing. this was only during a 30m window.

ivy: net duplicates to credit: FALCON_NEURO 79,000, NOVUS_AI 9,000, OYSTER_IO 11,700. embed unit price $0.0004. credits: FALCON = $31.60, NOVUS = $3.60, OYSTER = $4.68. total $39.88.

acct_maya: NOVUS already disputed similar earlier this month; they expect full credit. FALCON is enterprise and will want a short note and audit CSV.

cfo_emma: three asks before approve: 1) attach audit CSVs for each account, 2) confirm dedupe confidence and matching criteria, 3) include a one-line customer-facing reason and internal remediation plan.

ivy: CSVs uploaded: s3://redwood-recon/2149005555/falcon_dup.csv, s3://redwood-recon/2149005555/novus_dup.csv, s3://redwood-recon/2149005555/oyster_dup.csv. dedupe method: exact sha256(payload) + model id + size. confidence high.

ops_rahul: remediation: revert experiment flag, add safe-guard to avoid emitting server-side retry tokens during tests, and schedule a deploy to enforce idempotency header requirement at edge. product ticket PROD-2045 created.

cfo_emma: approve credits. create credit memos and include memo text: "Credit: non-billable duplicate requests caused by internal rate-cap experiment on 2026-04-05. See attached audit CSV." Also CC account teams.

billing.bot: Creating credit memos: CM-2026-0405-FALCON-31.60, CM-2026-0405-NOVUS-3.60, CM-2026-0405-OYSTER-4.68. Drafts created. Reference thread 2149005555.

ivy: applying backfill now; will post when ledger delta is staged.

billing.bot: Draft credit memos created and awaiting finance finalization.

ops_rahul: backfill complete: overrides applied FALCON 79,000, NOVUS 9,000, OYSTER 11,700. ledger delta total -$39.88.

billing.bot: Credit memos finalized and posted. CM refs: CM-2026-0405-FALCON-31.60, CM-2026-0405-NOVUS-3.60, CM-2026-0405-OYSTER-4.68. Notifications queued to account contacts.

acct_maya: confirmed NOVUS accepted credit and appreciated the proactive note.

cfo_emma: please include a short incident note in billing ops and mark PROD-2045 as P1 for idempotency enforcement. thanks.

ivy: will file postmortem and close this thread.
